ar03_gate: A new customer registers, enters AXIOM, creates a project, and runs an entitled safe task without manual database provisioning.

evidence: auth/musitu_axiom_oauth_worker.mjs exposes OAuth discovery, dynamic client registration, authorize, token, userinfo, revoke.
Authorization currently authenticates an existing MUSITU account key and issues access/refresh credentials.
.github/workflows/axiom-customer-provision-contract.yml proves a /v1/admin/customers provisioning route exists in protected runtime.
.github/workflows/axiom-admin-create-customer-contract.yml proves an adminCreateCustomer runtime function exists.
reusable_runtime_evidence.gap: Admin/protected provisioning is not self-service signup.

evidence: OAuth worker revokes access/refresh-linked API keys.
reusable_runtime_evidence.gap: No customer-facing key-handle lifecycle or recovery-safe UI authority is proven.

evidence: OAuth/plugin surfaces reference existing account entitlement.
Production entitlement workflows and customer metering contracts exist.
reusable_runtime_evidence.gap: No server-backed onboarding entitlement assignment contract is proven for a newly registered user.

evidence: axiom_interface/vnext/authorization_gateway.js binds project/workload/agent identity, budgets, S0-S5 risk, and independent approvals.
reusable_runtime_evidence.gap: Browser-side authority is not a complete server identity authority.

evidence: axiom_interface/vnext/project_work_memory_bridge.js opens browser/local ProjectStore, OutcomeContractStore, and MemoryGraphStore.
reusable_runtime_evidence.gap: No server-backed first-project creation tied to a new account is proven.

missing_or_not_proven: Ordinary login/session authority independent from account-key OAuth consent
Server audit history for identity lifecycle
Entitled S0 task execution from a newly registered account without manual DB provisioning

implementation_decision.path: Build an isolated, provider-independent AR-03 identity/onboarding authority under recovery/ar03 using SQLite and explicit server-shaped contracts.
implementation_decision.reuse_policy: Admit existing OAuth/MCP and authorization contracts later through adapters; do not copy protected encrypted runtime source or global credentials.
